task_contracts.person_context: NiceGUI Base developer navigating a governed engineering UI platform.
task_contracts.current_object: Workbench start/build/catalog/data/settings surface or selected navigation destination.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Choose the next supported construction, reference, or governance task.
required_information: registered capability names and task fit
source/runtime or quality status when applicable
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Canonical pixels show governed navigation, labeled task/capability objects, gallery previews and named actions. R16 route diagnostics separately recorded current routes ready.
task_contracts.recovery: Search/refinement and return to governed navigation; gallery no-results recovery is source-described but not state-bound in this atlas.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Open a matching registered example/pattern or continue into build/catalog/detail.
task_contracts.assessment: No material clarity gap in inspected normal states. Dynamic search/no-results/favorite/compare restoration remains evidence debt.

task_contracts.person_context: Framework engineer inspecting an existing component, interaction or data authority.
task_contracts.current_object: Named lab section such as controls, forms, data, charts, engineering, state or performance specimen.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Determine whether the registered behavior covers an application need.
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Pixels identify specimens and show controls/outputs; chart evidence includes toolbar, plot and data-alternative diagnostic metadata.
task_contracts.recovery: Return to Explorer/gallery or use registered pattern/catalog navigation.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Use the public framework authority or open a full reference pattern/application.
task_contracts.assessment: No canonical material task gap found. Lab state examples are not proof of dynamic state ownership.

task_contracts.person_context: Application builder comparing an end-to-end registered page pattern.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Select the closest pattern for the dominant user task.
required_information: filters, selected object, details and actions
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Reference pages show named patterns and current content hierarchy; existing responsive diagnostics include data-explorer and analysis-workspace examples.
task_contracts.recovery: Return to pattern index and choose a different registered pattern.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Scaffold/use the registered pattern; do not hand-assemble competing state ownership.
task_contracts.assessment: No material task gap found in reviewed examples; overlay and state transitions require browser evidence.

task_contracts.person_context: Framework engineer inspecting one reusable component contract.
task_contracts.current_object: The selected catalog component and its specimen variants.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Check purpose, variants, enabled/disabled and visual semantics.
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Canonical surfaces present component titles/specimens with a coherent neutral/semantic visual language.
task_contracts.recovery: Return to component gallery and select another authority.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Use public API and its documented contract.
task_contracts.assessment: No material static clarity gap found; dynamic focus/disabled states are not fully established by pixels.

task_contracts.person_context: Framework engineer reviewing a composed pattern before adoption.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Confirm the pattern solves the full task without local competing ownership.
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Studio pages name compositions and expose task structure with governed layout.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Adopt registered pattern or select a closer alternative.
task_contracts.assessment: No material normal-state defect observed; open drawers/dialogs and task transitions are evidence debt.

task_contracts.person_context: Process/FDC/SPC or RCA engineer reviewing a population or measured signal.
task_contracts.current_object: Named chart/analysis (SPC control chart, capability, FDC overlay, distribution, wafer or RCA view).
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Interpret signal against limits/context, inspect evidence, and decide whether to drill or compare.
required_information: full-data alternative and legitimate drill/zoom/reset actions
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Normal canonical pixels provide named engineering context and chart control/data affordances. Existing dark diagnostics show the explicit Dark mismatch on eleven consumers while System dark succeeds on paired routes.
task_contracts.recovery: Chart data view/export/reset and route navigation are visible/source-owned; interaction outcome is not inferred from static pixels.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Inspect data, zoom or drill to a registered evidence surface.
task_contracts.assessment: Finding V3-203-001 on 11 dark-theme consumers. Other normal-state task structure is adequate in reviewed canonical pixels.

task_contracts.person_context: Process engineer/application builder evaluating a runnable workflow starter.
task_contracts.current_object: One of eight registered semiconductor application recipes.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Choose a recipe matching the workflow and inspect its data/evidence panels.
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Recipe screenshots identify the workflow and operational information; explicit dark diagnostics establish the same shared chart defect on three recipe routes.
task_contracts.recovery: Use recipe/gallery navigation to compare another workflow.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Start from the registered recipe with a valid data adapter.
task_contracts.assessment: One affected recipe route per Finding V3-203-001 list; no additional normal-state task gap established.

task_contracts.person_context: Engineer following a full reference application workflow.
task_contracts.current_object: Integrated SPC control center, FDC health center, or excursion investigation.
task_contracts.primary_decision_action: Review current engineering context and take the next registered investigation action.
required_information: metrics, plots, table/evidence and context-preserving actions
task_contracts.visible_or_semantic_outcome: Canonical screenshots show integrated pages; the SPC application explicit and system dark diagnostics both render its chart dark.
task_contracts.recovery: Use application navigation and its investigation/workspace patterns.
task_contracts.next_legitimate_action: Inspect evidence or continue through the registered analysis workflow.
task_contracts.assessment: No material normal-state task-truth gap found in current evidence; does not certify task operation or human acceptance.

assessment: All eight registered surface families were reviewed against current person/object/action/outcome/recovery/next-step intent. One theme-dependent chart readability defect is recorded; no task contract is claimed universally accepted.
